## How it was tested

- [ ] `make lint` passes
- [ ] `make check` on a DGX Spark (only if the change affects what runs there; say which DGX OS and image tags)

## Checklist

- [ ] No real addresses, host names, keys or tokens in the diff, the description or attached logs
- [ ] New or changed images, tools and Actions are pinned to an exact version
- [ ] `docs/decisions.md` updated if this changes how the Spark is set up
